failure.title: Tablet client detail retained nested two-column layouts that crushed profile values
failure.note: The retained responsive CSS and screenshot-review summary record the 768x1024 client-detail failure: the outer content and inner profile remained two columns, leaving coaching-profile values close to one character wide.
failure.diagnosis: The application switched to its tablet navigation at 980px, but content-layout did not collapse until 720px. At 768px the client page therefore combined a constrained outer two-column grid with its inner two-column definition layout, producing technically non-overflowing but unreadable values.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
